text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] APAC edge gateway elevated 5xx (502/504) and increased Redis timeouts detected. Rate: 12% across apac-edge-01..04. Severity: P1. Please respond.

maria (eng-oncall): I'm paged, looking. Can someone attach recent grafana and logs? :eyes:

aj (eng-sre): grabbing graphs — latency spike at 10:42 UTC, connection errors to redis-cluster-apac. Errors show `i/o timeout` and `connection reset`.

devin (eng-runtime): runtime is seeing KV cache failures (prefix cache) which converts to 502s when fallback path hits. I see many `cache.Get` -> `redis: read tcp ...: i/o timeout` in logs.

sasha (eng-infra): redis nodes show high iowait on hosts apac-db-1/2. Also network tx errors on eni-xyz. Rolling restarts might help but risky. Scaling up read replicas recommended.

maria (eng-oncall): Are we seeing capacity saturation or networking? aj what do logs on the redis side show?

aj (eng-sre): Redis slowlog has lots of blocked clients and epoll_wait timeouts. `netstat -anp` on apac-db-1 shows many TIME_WAIT and a few RST. Kernel dropped packets counters increasing.

devin (eng-runtime): We can flip routing policy to route APAC traffic to EU fallback for safety. ops-bot, can we set `routing.weight` for apac->eu to 100%?

ops-bot: running `rctl routes update --from=apac --to=eu --policy=fallback --weight=100` ... done. Confirming traffic shift 1m ago :white_check_mark:

maria (eng-oncall): Customer impact: majority of real-time generation calls from APAC returning 502s. Embeddings and batch jobs unaffected (different routing). Lina/Ben please notify top customers in APAC.

lina (product): I'll draft a notification. High-level: degraded service for real-time generation in APAC, we've shifted traffic to EU as temporary mitigation. ETA for full APAC recovery unknown. Draft:

ben (customer-success): pinging affected customers now. Will include workaround: set region=eu in requests for lower latency during mitigation.

devin (eng-runtime): Short term mitigation: disable prefix KV cache to avoid heavy redis dependency. Command:

```
// toggle prefix cache
curl -X POST https://internal-config.internal/v1/features/kv_cache_disable \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"apac","value":true}'
```

maria (eng-oncall): Do it. Expect higher token costs but less 5xxs.

sasha (eng-infra): I'll increase redis instance type on apac-db-1 and add one read replica. Running Terraform apply for scale-up now.

aj (eng-sre): Also adding iptables rule to drop suspected noisy source? Not yet. Investigating sudden client retries that may amplify load.

devin (eng-runtime): After disabling kv cache, I see error rate drop from 12% -> 3% in 90s. Some residual 502s from lingering connections. Pushing a graceful restart of apac-edge-02 to flush connections.

ops-bot: `k run-pod-proxy apac-edge-02 --restart` initiated.

maria (eng-oncall): On-call handoff note: I'm going to handoff to AJ in 40m as I have a separate paged incident. AJ please take lead.

aj (eng-sre): Taking lead. I'll coordinate post-incident and own follow-up actions. Current status: traffic routed to EU, kv cache disabled in APAC, redis scaling in progress. Severity remains P1 until APAC returns to <0.5% errors.

lina (product): Customers updated. Response from one large customer: "Thanks, we'll route to EU for now. Please keep us posted."

ben (customer-success): Logged all customer contacts in zendesk. Will consolidate list for postmortem.

devin (eng-runtime): Next step: when redis nodes finish scaling and network counters stabilize, we will re-enable prefix cache behind a kill-switch and can gradually shift traffic back via `routing` weight stepdown 20% intervals.

aj (eng-sre): ETA for redis scale: ~18m. I'll monitor kernel counters and connection churn.

sasha (eng-infra): Scale completed at 10:59 UTC. Observability shows iowait returning to baseline and net drops reduced.

devin (eng-runtime): Re-enabled prefix cache in staging, smoke tests pass. I'll apply to apac with canary 10%.

ops-bot: `rctl routes update --from=apac --to=apac --policy=fallback --weight=0` (restoring) ... partial: canary 10% applied.

maria (eng-oncall): Monitoring. Error rate at 0.6% after canary. Proceed to 50%.

aj (eng-sre): Proceeding. No customer complaints. Increasing to 50% now.

devin (eng-runtime): 50% -> 0.4% errors. Proceeding to 100% traffic back to APAC.

ops-bot: routing restored to normal. :white_check_mark:

maria (eng-oncall): Marking incident resolved. Timeline and initial action items:
- Cause: Redis node IO/network contention causing prefix cache failures leading to 5xx.
- Mitigation: Route APAC->EU, disable kv cache, scale redis, restart edge nodes, gradual traffic restore.
- Postmortem owners: aj (lead), devin (runtime ops), sasha (infra). Target ETA for postmortem: 48h.

lina (product): Will prepare customer-facing postmortem summary.

ben (customer-success): Closing followups in zendesk. If customers need credits, flag for billing.

maria (eng-oncall): Thanks everyone. Handoff to AJ complete. I'll update incident tracker and change on-call schedule.

aj (eng-sre): Thanks. Adding action: add autoscaling for redis io and alert for kernel packet drops. Also consider fallback mode that avoids redis for prefix cache when network errors detected.

incident-bot: Incident closed by aj (eng-sre) at 11:10 UTC. Postmortem assigned.
